sections.heading: Getting Help
paragraphs: Whether you're learning the controls, troubleshooting a problem or reporting an issue, we're here to help you get the most from ZXTank.
As the game continues to evolve, this support page will be updated with verified guidance, known issues and frequently requested information.

sections.heading: Troubleshooting
paragraphs: If you experience an unexpected problem, make sure you're using the latest version of ZXTank, then restart the game and your device before trying again.
Many temporary issues can be resolved by updating the app, restarting your device or checking that your internet connection is stable when using online features.

sections.heading: Game Center
paragraphs: If achievements or leaderboards are not updating correctly, confirm that you are signed in to Apple Game Center and that your device has an active internet connection.
Some Game Center features may not update immediately if your device is temporarily offline.

sections.heading: Reporting a Problem
paragraphs: If you need to contact BarkinMad Studios, please include as much information as possible to help us investigate the issue quickly.
Useful information includes your ZXTank version, device model, iOS version, the game mode you were playing, what happened, whether the issue can be repeated and any relevant screenshots.

sections.heading: Contact BarkinMad Studios
paragraphs: Visit the [BarkinMad Studios Contact Page](/contact) to report bugs, request support or provide feedback about ZXTank.
Never include passwords, Apple account credentials or other sensitive personal information when contacting support.

sections.heading: Privacy & Related Information
paragraphs: For information about data handling, advertising or privacy, please read the [ZXTank Privacy Information](/apps/zxtank/privacy).
You can also find additional gameplay information in the How to Play, Controls, Complete Guide and Frequently Asked Questions sections of the ZXTank documentation.
